open.question: WG-vs-PRINT — the flexible spell collection’s SHAPE. Print: the collection holds a number of spells equal to your TOTAL class spell slots, distributed as you like (a level-3 cleric could collect one 1st-rank and three 2nd-rank spells). WG forces the per-rank shape: exactly as many collected spells of each rank as you have slots of that rank (two and two). We implemented WG’s per-rank shape (it is also the only shape our repertoire vocabulary holds today). Confirm per-rank, or rule that the collection must be a flat pool.
open.printed: AoN archetype-99: "The number of spells in your spell collection each day equals the total number of spell slots you get each day from your class spells" — a single total, and Table 5-1's "Collection" column is one number per level (4 at level 3). The only distribution rule print states is in Heightening Spells: "The only restriction is that you must select at least one 1st-level spell for your collection each time you prepare, ensuring that you can use all your spell slots each day" — a sentence that would be meaningless if the collection were already forced to hold one spell per rank.
open.theirs: WG routes it through their generic SPONTANEOUS-REPERTOIRE casting source (wg-data.sql class_archetype row 149, `defineCastingSource` value "CLERIC:::SPONTANEOUS-REPERTOIRE:::DIVINE:::ATTRIBUTE_WIS") with `giveSpellSlot` amounts of 2 at each rank — a per-rank repertoire of 2+2, not a flat pool of 4 with a >=1-first-rank floor. Their own replacement text still quotes the flat rule ("The number of spells in your spell collection each day equals the total number of spell slots you get each day from your cleric spells"), so their data and the print they reproduce disagree.
open.ours: Nothing — we have no collection at all (see the previous finding). Our prepared branch (src/rules/build.ts:3627-3634) is per-rank, and the spontaneous branch we would reuse (src/rules/build.ts:3550-3559, cap enforced by `repCap` at src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx:609) is also per-rank, sized by that rank's slot count.
